helpContent.acoustid: Enter the Application API Key obtained after registering an application to look up acoustic fingerprints. A user account API key is for submitting fingerprints and cannot replace it.
helpContent.aiBudget: Limits daily usage by number of model calls. A single conversation may involve multiple calls, so this does not represent permitted daily chat messages.
helpContent.aiProtocol: Select the request protocol actually supported by the server. Chat Completions and Responses have different fields; select according to the model provider's API documentation.
helpContent.aiProvider: Adapters handle parameter differences between providers. When using compatible services, select the adapter matching the actual API.
helpContent.aiStream: Stream responses progressively when supported by the model. Seeing partial content does not indicate completion; final status depends on request results.
helpContent.aiTimeout: Maximum wait time for a single model request. Incomplete status is reported upon timeout; extending wait time does not guarantee successful response.
helpContent.albumGain: Applies the same dB adjustment across all tracks in this album, preserving track dynamics. Only affects playback for the current account without modifying audio files.
helpContent.application: Review mode applies changes after your confirmation; auto mode only applies to checked types. MCP credentials must also have corresponding operational permissions.
helpContent.backgroundAI: Authorizes automated tasks such as scheduled scans to use this connection. Manually initiated tasks do not require this option.
helpContent.cacheDays: Retention period is calculated from when transcode cache was last accessed. Clearing cache never deletes original audio in the managed library.
helpContent.cacheSize: Target size limit for transcode cache in MiB. Active cache files may defer cleanup, tracked separately from music library storage.
helpContent.candidate: The same track may appear on original albums, compilations, and live recordings. Match score is a search clue rather than factual certainty; verify album and release date.
helpContent.clipping: Limits amplification based on known peak levels to prevent clipping distortion. When peaks are unknown, only attenuation is permitted, so applied gain may be less than requested.
helpContent.counter_added: Number of tracks newly added to the library index in this run.
helpContent.counter_assets_copied: Number of accompanying lyric and cover files copied with tracks, not counted as songs.
helpContent.counter_conflicts: Existing copy conflicts with source; library copy is kept with conflict reason recorded to prevent overwriting.
helpContent.counter_converted: Number of tracks generated by supported conversion or CUE splitting workflows.
helpContent.counter_copied: Audio files copied to the managed library, without moving or modifying import sources.
helpContent.counter_duplicates: Identified duplicate content, skipped copying an additional copy in this run.
helpContent.counter_errors: Items that could not be processed in this run; check the error list below for details.
helpContent.counter_missing: Managed files corresponding to existing library records were not found in this run.
helpContent.counter_review: Insufficient metadata or requires confirmation; staged for review before proceeding with import.
helpContent.counter_skipped: Files not processed in this run, such as unsupported formats or ignored content; not an error.
helpContent.counter_unchanged: Files verified unchanged in this run, retaining existing library records.
helpContent.counter_updated: Existing track files or tags changed, and the index was updated in this run.
helpContent.counter_visited: Number of files checked in this run, which differs from newly imported tracks.
helpContent.counter_waiting: Files are still changing or have temporary download markers; waiting to stabilize before processing.
helpContent.diagnostic: Copy this identifier to locate corresponding request logs for troubleshooting; this identifier is not a model or platform API key.
helpContent.downloadSuffix: These suffixes indicate incomplete downloads; matching files or directories will be deferred from import until the downloader removes the temporary mark and files stabilize.
helpContent.fingerprint: This network check does not read audio or calculate fingerprints. Fingerprints are generated by the server during song recognition, requiring only an Application API Key without an extra fingerprint key.
helpContent.fullScan: Re-reads tags from managed library audio files. Preserves manual corrections in the database without writing changes back to import sources.
helpContent.gainPreamp: Adjusts overall volume on top of automatic loudness normalization. Positive values are louder, negative quieter; preamp is not applied when auto normalization is disabled.
helpContent.gainResult: Requested gain is the target calculated from settings; applied gain is the value after peak protection. Differences usually indicate protection limiting amplification.
helpContent.handoff: Cross-device handoff only resumes from playback explicitly paused recently on another device. Playback remains paused on load; disabling hides handoff prompts.
helpContent.history: Cleans up chat history by conversation last updated time; existing drafts, playlists, and music are kept. Save any conversations you wish to keep before cleaning up.
helpContent.hostAllowlist: Restricts which domains or IP addresses the server accepts requests from. Before enabling, make sure to include the address currently in use, as well as public addresses used by mobile and desktop clients.
helpContent.importInterval: Background polling interval for checking import directories, not per-track processing time. Import sources are read-only; files are copied to the managed library upon import.
helpContent.importStable: Waits until file size and modification time remain unchanged for this duration before attempting import, reducing incomplete reads. In-progress .part files wait for completion.
helpContent.listenCount: Counted when listening past half the duration or 4 minutes, recorded once per playback session; differs from clicking play.
helpContent.lyricGoal: Tracks that already meet the target quality level are typically skipped. Levels describe timing and language capabilities, not guaranteed alignment with current audio.
helpContent.lyricNoMatch: No qualifying candidates found in this query; this does not mean lyrics do not exist online. Try again later or switch sources.
helpContent.lyricOffset: Shifts the timing of all lines as a whole without altering lyric text. In seconds, suitable when the entire lyric has a consistent time offset.
helpContent.lyricPreference: Word-timed preference favors original word-level timing; bilingual preference favors candidates with translations. Version and duration alignment should still be checked first.
helpContent.lyricReady: Lyric candidates found for review, without replacing currently active lyrics. Preview the version and timing before confirming.
helpContent.lyricSkipped: Reused previously scanned records or skipped tracks meeting target quality in this run; not a scan failure. Choose forced rescan if a new search is required.
helpContent.manualValue: This is a manually saved value; batch selection preserves it by default. The candidate will only replace it when this field is explicitly selected for acceptance.
helpContent.mcpScopes: Only grant operations required by this tool credential. Reading, generating drafts, and applying changes are separate permissions; account settings do not expand original credential scopes.
helpContent.memory: Long-term memory stores explicitly provided preferences or profile information for future conversation reference. View and delete items here; avoid saving sensitive secrets.
helpContent.metadataVersion: Metadata versions detect concurrent modifications. When track data changes, older candidates may no longer apply and must be reloaded or searched again.
helpContent.modelConnection: Local mode only uses music library search without calling external models. Personal connections are for personal use only; shared instance connections are authorized by administrators, with budgets calculated based on the selected connection.
helpContent.nativeSearch: Allows the model to use web search tools provided by the vendor. Availability depends on model and account permissions; calls may incur additional costs.
helpContent.networkCheck: Reachable indicates the service responded, but does not guarantee metadata exists for this track. "Not tested this run" means the check was skipped, not failed.
helpContent.offlineLimit: Limits offline music storage in this browser, not server library capacity. The browser's own storage quota may also constrain available space.
helpContent.offlineQuality: Only affects future offline downloads. Selecting AAC transcodes lossless sources to save space, while lossy audio retains original quality.
helpContent.outputTokens: Limits output tokens for a single model call. Tokens do not equal character counts, and thinking tokens also consume output budget on some models; reaching the limit may truncate responses.
helpContent.playbackQuality: Original audio plays source files directly; selecting AAC transcodes lossless tracks at the chosen bitrate, while lossy audio retains original quality.
helpContent.pluginEnabled: Requires saving after checking. Disabling stops new queries from this plugin; previously selected lyrics and applied metadata are preserved.
helpContent.pluginMaintenance: Upgrading replaces code for the same plugin, preserves configuration, and disables it. Export only includes the plugin archive; disable and save before uninstalling.
helpContent.pluginUrl: Leave empty to use the plugin's built-in endpoint. Only provide an address if you host a compatible music API service yourself.
helpContent.providerPriority: Higher-ranked sources provide field candidates first. Existing manual edits and local album art are retained; candidates still require confirmation before applying.
helpContent.proxy: Follow environment variables to use existing server proxy; direct connection bypasses proxies; manual configuration uses the address below. Requests originate from the server.
helpContent.publicUrl: Enter a WildString address accessible by both mobile devices and computers, used for Last.fm authorization callbacks, e.g. https://music.example.com.
helpContent.reasoning: Controls the model's reasoning effort, not response length. Higher effort may be slower; available levels and effectiveness depend on the selected model.
helpContent.recommendations: Daily Library Mix only plays music in your library; Beyond your library suggests tracks outside your library without automatically downloading them.
helpContent.replayGain: Automatic loudness normalization: Track mode brings different tracks closer to equal loudness; Album mode preserves dynamics within an album, falling back to track values when album values are missing.
helpContent.reviewAccept: Applies selected tracks and fields to the database. Unselected fields and audio files are preserved; no further application step is needed.
helpContent.reviewReject: Archives current candidate and earlier duplicate records while keeping existing metadata. Other version candidates and newly queried results are unaffected.
helpContent.reviewSkip: Skips to the next track without applying or archiving candidates. This recommendation remains visible on future review visits.
helpContent.savedSecret: When displayed as "Saved / Configured", leaving empty keeps existing credentials. Only filling in a new value and saving replaces it; existing keys are never displayed in plaintext.
helpContent.scanForce: Re-queries previously scanned records and bypasses reusable query caches. Useful after updating plugins or re-verifying, but does not guarantee better lyrics.
helpContent.scanMode: Fill missing focuses on tracks without lyrics; Upgrade seeks higher-tier candidates against targets. Candidates still require verification and confirmation before use.
helpContent.scanRate: The minimum interval between requests for each source; larger values are slower. Low frequencies are recommended for background tasks to avoid upstream rate limits.
helpContent.searchBudget: Limits daily search service requests for the current account. One question may be split into multiple searches; search quota and model quota are tracked separately.
helpContent.searchService: Configure the search and web fetch service used by WildString here, set separately from the model's native internet access. When enabled, the assistant calls it as needed, counted against the search budget.
helpContent.sorting: Changes the display and playback order of the current list, remembered locally on this device. Albums play continuously by disc and track number; multi-disc subtitles do not interrupt the queue.
helpContent.sourcePriority: Lower numbers have higher priority, e.g. 20 ranks ahead of 50. This controls source preference order, but does not guarantee candidate accuracy; song versions should still be verified.
helpContent.stale: The track or metadata relied upon when generating the draft has changed. Re-review is required to avoid overwriting newer modifications.
helpContent.state_applied: Draft modifications applied to database; view results on corresponding tracks or playlists.
helpContent.state_approved: Draft approved, waiting for application results. Inspect diffs and status to avoid duplicate actions.
helpContent.state_partial: Only some steps succeeded; check results and errors. Successful modifications are retained.
helpContent.state_partial_success: Only some steps succeeded; check results and errors. Successful modifications are retained.
helpContent.state_paused_auth: Task lacks valid authorization; check model connection, sharing permissions, or credentials before resuming.
helpContent.state_paused_authorization: Task lacks valid authorization; check model connection, sharing permissions, or credentials before resuming.
helpContent.state_paused_budget: Task paused due to exhausted call budget; check connection quota or task budget before resuming.
helpContent.state_retry_wait: Temporarily incomplete; task is waiting for next retry. Check errors and retry schedule.
helpContent.state_sent: Notification API confirmed receipt; does not indicate recipient has read the message.
helpContent.state_unknown: No conclusive delivery result received after sending request; check target chat before resending to avoid duplicates.
helpContent.state_unsupported: Current server, model, or configuration does not provide this capability.
helpContent.state_unverified: This capability or step was not verified in this run; not a verification failure.
helpContent.summary: Compresses earlier conversation turns into a summary to reduce context size in subsequent requests. Summaries may omit details and do not become long-term memory.
helpContent.taskHistory: Finished queries are archived in history, while pending suggestions are retained separately. Task completion does not mean suggestions have been accepted.
helpContent.telegramQuiet: Quiet hours are calculated based on the selected time zone, muting routine notifications during this window. Select your own time zone to avoid confusion with the server's time zone.
helpContent.telegramTarget: Chat ID specifies the recipient chat; Topic ID is only used for group forum topics. Verify and send a test message after filling in to confirm the target.
helpContent.trackGain: Applies fine adjustments only to the current track, stacked with album adjustments. Positive values are louder, negative quieter; resetting to zero only clears this layer.
helpContent.transcodeJobs: Maximum concurrent transcoding tasks on the server. Higher values use more CPU and will not improve the quality of already generated cache files.
